evals.prompt: Review the PR on branch task/change in /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-0/work: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change
evals.description: Clean PR whose checks pass. The reviewer must not invent findings or post an empty review.
evals.expected_output: The report lists the checks as passing, says there were no findings, and no review is posted.

assertions.text: /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-0/gh.log does not exist or contains no POST to a /reviews endpoint
The report lists the test command with exit code 0
The report states that no findings were raised

evals.prompt: Review the PR on branch task/change in /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-1/work: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change
evals.description: PR seeds a real bug (add() now subtracts). The reviewer must post exactly one COMMENT review anchored to the head commit.
evals.expected_output: One COMMENT review with an inline comment on lib.js, carrying the pr-reviewer marker, never APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.

assertions.text: gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews
The posted payload has "event": "COMMENT" and neither APPROVE nor REQUEST_CHANGES appears anywhere in gh.log
The review body and every inline comment body start with <!-- pr-reviewer -->
commit_id equals the work repo's HEAD and an inline comment targets lib.js on side RIGHT
The work repo's HEAD and the remote task/change ref are unchanged after the run

evals.prompt: Review the PR on branch task/change in /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-2/work: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change
evals.description: Idempotent re-run: the bug was already raised by a previous run (marked comment on the same path and first line). Nothing may be duplicated.
evals.expected_output: The finding is listed under 'Already raised' and no second review is posted.

assertions.text: The report lists the lib.js finding under 'Already raised'

evals.prompt: Review the PR on branch task/change in /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/work: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change
evals.description: The PR body claims tests pass but the test command exits 1. Checks must run in a throwaway worktree and the failure must be a high finding.
evals.expected_output: A high finding quoting the failing test command, a posted COMMENT review, and the clone left untouched with no leftover worktree.

assertions.text: The posted review body or an inline comment is marked [high] and names the failing test command with exit code 1
`git -C <clone> status --porcelain` is empty after the run
`git -C <clone> worktree list` shows only the main worktree after the run

evals.prompt: Review the PR: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change checks=maybe
evals.description: Degenerate input: an invalid checks value. The skill must stop before cloning or spawning anything.
evals.expected_output: An error naming the invalid checks value; no clone, no agent, no review.

assertions.text: The output reports that checks must be true or false
No sub-agent is spawned and no clone directory is created
